_doc: Languages you are learning. Required section. The daily 5-minute pack uses current_focus; weekly and monthly mix all languages in 'learning'. Always show the native script plus romanization (and a translation). Add or remove languages freely, or tell Claude.

learning.name: Japanese
learning.goal: conversation: speaking and listening with native speakers

practice_style: conversation first: useful phrases, short dialogues, listening, speaking out loud; correct gently
_doc_native: native_content_ok false means: no native videos, podcasts or shorts in this language yet. Only beginner lessons explained in a language you know. Set it to true when you are ready for native content.
